description: Scans the site, detects its consent tool (Cookiebot, iubenda, CookieYes, Termly, Cookie Script, Complianz, or others), maps the page count to that vendor's list tier, and returns the annual cost next to Shortbread's flat price. Sites with no consent tool get Cookiebot as the reference. The `incumbent.basis` field states the assumption behind the number.

domains.description: How many domains the account runs; agencies get a different Cookiebot tier

name: compare_cookiebot_cost
title: Compare a site's consent tool price with Shortbread
